title: eBay UK announces Simple Delivery rollout for private sellers
summary: In a documented announcement published 4 April 2025, eBay UK said Simple Delivery would be the only delivery method for private sellers listing most items starting 15 April 2025.
body_markdown: Eligible existing listings were scheduled to transition from 7 April through the end of April 2025. These are announced rollout dates, not proof that every eligible seller or listing was switched on one day.
affected_sellers: UK private sellers on eBay.co.uk listing eligible items; not business sellers
source_title: eBay UK staff announcement — Updates on Simple Delivery
